newsitem.title: USA: United Air chooses advertising partners - sources.
newsitem.headline: United Air chooses advertising partners - sources.

text.p: United Airlines, a unit of UAL Corp, has chosen Fallon McElligott and Young & Rubicam for an advertising account with billings estimated at $100 million annually, industry sources said on Friday.
A United Airlines spokesperson would not confirm the report.
The decision, which completes a three month review, would mean an end to a 31-year relationship with Chicago-based Leo Burnett Co.
Yesterday, United had said it was 90 percent sure an announcement would be made Friday.
Industry sources expect an announcement at 1530 CDT today.
Fallon McElligott is a Minneapolis-based advertising agency which earlier this year created advertising for the launch of McDonald's Corp's Arch Deluxe sandwich and subsequent sandwich introductions.

Leo Burnett is the No. 1 U.S. agency with $2.48 billion in billings last year, Young & Rubicam is No. 10, with $2.14 billion and Fallon McElligott is No. 54, with $269 million in billings, according to Advertising Age.
